Corrected initial PVR range from 5 to less than 8 to the guideline wording 5 to 8 Wood units; retained uncertainty of VSD closure after therapy reduces PVR below 5.
Added individualized intracranial aneurysm screening with brain MR/CT angiography, explicitly separated from thoracic surveillance and not assigned an unsupported fixed screening interval.
Added radiofemoral delay and characteristic collateral-related rib notching/figure-of-3 signs, with limits on using these to establish intervention eligibility.

Replaced arbitrary regurgitation/volume waiting thresholds and giveaway PAH-treatment wording with competing serial CMR, pulmonary vasodilator assessment and medical-optimization pathways; explained their appropriate settings.

Specified 2025 dual-therapy recommendation and LVEF >40% qualification; added refractory-disease lung-plus-defect-repair versus heart-lung transplant context.
Added precise 2025 surgical indication: at least moderate TR with HF, worsening exercise capacity or progressive RV systolic dysfunction; included qualified asymptomatic intervention features.

Added current recommendation for surgical systemic tricuspid replacement in symptomatic severe TR with normal/mildly impaired systemic RV function; distinguished this from usual Ebstein cone reconstruction.
Added complete 2022 ESC/ERS precapillary PH thresholds and PVR formula using Qp rather than Qs in shunt physiology.
Added plastic bronchitis as a related Fontan lymphatic complication, cast/airway recognition, bronchoscopic management and targeted lymphatic assessment.
Added scimitar drainage pattern, imaging clue and associated pulmonary/arterial anatomy.
Replaced implausible pregnancy management choices with four competing mWHO classifications; retained individualized counselling and clarified symptom class versus pregnancy-risk class.
